summary: Associate Professor faculty opportunities in theoretical physics. Employer-submitted November12,2026 call for faculty positions in2027 explicitly requires receipt by December31,2026. Faculty recruitment includes talent-programme tenure-track and three-to-five-year fixed-term associate-professor routes across theoretical physics.

Tenure-track Faculty in Experimental Particle Physics — ATLAS. Employer-submitted call posted November12,2026 explicitly closes January15,2027 and expects March2027 appointment. Tenure-track ATLAS search spanning collider analysis, reconstruction, triggers, instrumentation and machine learning.

Assistant Professor of Teaching in Physics and Engineering Physics. Official department call closes December15,2026 and anticipates July1,2027 start. Tenure-track Educational Leadership appointment focused on physics and engineering-physics teaching, laboratories and capstone projects.
